topic: Troubleshooting high laptop temperature during analytics
summary_markdown: A discussion occurred regarding the laptop overheating when running certain operations, specifically those involving inventory and analytics. It was noted that while a direct correlation is not yet confirmed, the issue seems related to the analytics process. Suggestions were made to check Chrome's task manager to identify resource-intensive tabs. The participant agreed to monitor the temperature fluctuations over time, acknowledging that the current observations are subjective.
decisions: Monitor laptop temperature and performance during specific operations
action_items: Participant will observe and track instances of high CPU/temperature usage related to analytics.
